hypothesis: If the claim holds, oceanic islands will hold far fewer species than continental plots of equal area.
pass_criterion: For at least 20 oceanic islands, the median ratio of recorded species richness to that of equal-area continental plots in the same latitude band is < 0.5 for each of birds and vascular plants, significant at p < 0.01 after controlling for sampling effort.
fail_criterion: Median ratio >= 0.8 or no significant difference.
interpretation: 'Species of all kinds' is tested in taxa with good coverage (vascular plants, birds). Equal area is matched using island area and mainland grid cells of that area. Sampling bias in occurrence data is controlled by rarefaction.

dataset.name: GBIF Occurrence Download / Occurrence API (plants and birds)
dataset.why_it_fits: Fields used: speciesKey, decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude, island, countryCode, year. Species counts are computed per island and per equal-area mainland cell.
